cues.text: The school entranceway, among students heading out. You walk up to Yuko, both of you with your bags; she stands looking at her phone.
Two girls walk up and stop in front of Yuko, one in black tights and one with bright hair who keeps a hand at her collar. Yuko turns to face them, and so do you.
The girl in black tights walks off, and the girl with bright hair hurries after her.
